scope: Two externally scheduled SEND/ACK round trips on unchanged endpoints; then idempotent retry. No new engine behavior is added.
time_coordinate: t_index is the new harness's logical action order; native RAW uses local record_no and predecessor links. No physical time base is introduced.
notation: The archived Corner Relay packet uses T for transition relation. This harness does not rename it or equate it with the user's temporal-axis T. O2 may denote O's changed returned state, not a new endpoint identity.
